meta.name: constitutional-ai
meta.description: Anthropic's method for training harmless AI through self-improvement. Two-phase approach - supervised learning with self-critique/revision, then RLAIF (RL from AI Feedback). Use for safety alignment, reducing harmful outputs without human labels. Powers Claude's safety system.

copy.tagline: 用自我批评和AI反馈训练模型更安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做AI安全对齐，想减少模型有害输出。
copy.tagline_en: Train safer models with self-critique and AI feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on AI safety alignment and want to reduce harmful model outputs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用一套原则（宪法）自我批评和修改回答，使其更安全、无害，无需人工标注有害输出。
howto.when: 当 Claude 生成回答后，它会自动检查回答是否违反宪法原则，并在必要时进行修改。

say.text: 请根据宪法原则批评并修改你的回答。
say.note: Claude 会自我审查并改进回答。

say.text: 用链式思考逐步分析你的回答是否符合宪法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses a set of principles (constitution) to self-critique and revise its responses, making them safer and more harmless without requiring human labels for harmful outputs.
howto.when_en: When Claude generates a response, it automatically checks whether the response violates constitutional principles and revises it if necessary.

say_en.text: Please critique and revise your response according to the constitutional principles.
say_en.note: Claude will self-review and improve the response.

say_en.text: Use chain-of-thought to step-by-step analyze whether your response follows the constitution.
say_en.note: Claude will show its reasoning process.
